name: Pseudoarthrosis after Spinal Fusion
definition: Failure of intended bony fusion after spinal arthrodesis, potentially causing pain, hardware stress or deformity.

investigations.principle: CT is commonly used to assess fusion; dynamic radiographs and nuclear imaging are selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Optimize smoking, nutrition and bone health
amber: Revision fusion is considered when symptomatic pseudoarthrosis correlates with mechanical failure.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-sandhana failure phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Failure of intended bony fusion after spinal arthrodesis, potentially causing pain, hardware stress or deformity.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
